title: Open-source Mac app that runs EmbeddingGemma 2 locally to search your files by what’s in them
hook_text: Search Mac files locally with EmbeddingGemma 2.
script:
A new open-source Mac app lets you search your local documents using Google EmbeddingGemma 2.
The project uses Google EmbeddingGemma 2 models to handle embedding workloads entirely on personal hardware.
Instead of sending files to external servers, semantic search runs completely offline on macOS.
Google designed these models specifically for edge devices to parse text content quickly without cloud dependency.
This setup gives you private document retrieval without sacrificing data security or relying on internet access.
Would you install an open-source tool to search your Mac files offline?
